steps.name: Secrets and banned names in the tracked files (the repo is public)
The postgres client the database tests shell out to is present (else they would skip silently)
Tests (no live calls)
Stage-rename mutants (each reverted guard must be killed by its named test) (blocks)
Performance of the redaction patterns (blocks)
Install the scanners (locked)
System tools resolve outside the workspace
steps.run:
sys_tools="readlink sha256sum tar curl git grep date tr cut sort head mktemp rm touch"
venv_tools="python3 uv uvx"
[ -n "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ] || { echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE is empty"; exit 1; }
for c in $sys_tools $venv_tools; do
  p=$(command -v "$c") || { echo "$c not found"; exit 1; }
  case "$p" in /*) ;; *) echo "$c is not a file: $p"; exit 1;; esac
  venv_ok=0
  case " $venv_tools " in *" $c "*) case "$p" in "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/.venv/bin/*) venv_ok=1;; esac;; esac
  case "$p" in "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/*) [ "$venv_ok" = 1 ] || { echo "$c resolves inside the workspace: $p"; exit 1; };; esac
done
wr=$(readlink -f -- "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE") || exit 1
case "$wr" in /*) ;; *) echo "cannot resolve the workspace: $wr"; exit 1;; esac
for c in $sys_tools $venv_tools; do
  p=$(command -v "$c") || exit 1
  r=$(readlink -f -- "$p") || { echo "cannot resolve $c: $p"; exit 1; }
  case "$r" in /*) ;; *) echo "cannot resolve $c: $p"; exit 1;; esac
  case "$r" in "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/*|"$wr"/*) echo "$c is a link into the workspace: $p -> $r"; exit 1;; esac
done
[ -z "$(git ls-files -- .venv)" ] || { echo "files under .venv are tracked"; exit 1; }

steps.name: Workflow audit
Stale gitleaks ignore entries (each commit must exist on a fetched branch and not on main; entries expire)
steps.run:
fail=0
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = false ] || { echo "shallow clone: the history checks below would be blind"; fail=1; }
git rev-parse --verify -q origin/main > /dev/null || { echo "origin/main is missing"; fail=1; }
[ -f .gitleaksignore ] || { echo ".gitleaksignore is missing"; fail=1; touch .gitleaksignore; }
# any line that is not blank, not a comment and not a 40-hex fingerprint entry escapes the checks below
if grep -nvE '^(#|$|[0-9a-f]{40}:[^:]+:(generic-api-key|curl-auth-user|private-key):[0-9]+$)' .gitleaksignore | cut -d: -f1 | grep .; then echo "malformed gitleaks ignore line(s) at the line numbers above (entry = <40-hex sha>:<path>:<generic-api-key|curl-auth-user|private-key>:<line>)"; fail=1; fi
while read -r sha; do
  [ -n "$sha" ] || continue
  if ! git branch -r --contains "$sha" | grep -qE '^ *origin/(core/cloud-handover|handover-src/c1a-8460813|core/P2d-1)$'; then echo "stale ignore entry (not on a named handover branch): $sha"; fail=1; fi
  if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$sha" origin/main; then echo "ignore entry is in main history (needs an owner decision): $sha"; fail=1; fi
done < <(grep -oE '^[0-9a-f]{40}' .gitleaksignore | sort -u)
[ "$(grep -cE '^# EXPIRES ' .gitleaksignore || true)" -le 1 ] || { echo "more than one EXPIRES line"; fail=1; }
exp=$(grep -oE '^# EXPIRES [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' .gitleaksignore | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f3 || true)
if [ -n "$exp" ] && [ "$(date -u -d "$exp" +%F 2>/dev/null)" != "$exp" ]; then echo "EXPIRES is not a real date: $exp"; fail=1; fi
if [ -z "$exp" ] && grep -qE '^[0-9a-f]{40}:' .gitleaksignore; then echo "entries exist but no '# EXPIRES YYYY-MM-DD' line"; fail=1; fi
if [ -n "$exp" ] && [ "$(date -u +%F)" \> "$exp" ]; then echo "gitleaks ignore entries expired on $exp"; fail=1; fi
if [ -n "$exp" ] && [ "$exp" \> "$(date -u -d '+90 days' +%F)" ]; then echo "EXPIRES is more than 90 days ahead: $exp"; fail=1; fi
# the temporary allowlist in .gitleaks.toml lives and dies with branch core/cloud-handover and the same EXPIRES date
[ -f .gitleaks.toml ] || { echo ".gitleaks.toml is missing"; fail=1; touch .gitleaks.toml; }
if grep -qE 'targetRules|handover/' .gitleaks.toml; then
  have_branch=1
  git rev-parse --verify -q origin/core/cloud-handover > /dev/null || { have_branch=0; echo "temporary allowlist in .gitleaks.toml outlived branch core/cloud-handover: delete it"; fail=1; }
  [ -n "$exp" ] || { echo "temporary allowlist in .gitleaks.toml needs the EXPIRES date in .gitleaksignore"; fail=1; }
  # the allowlist is path-wide, not branch-wide: no such path may exist in this checkout's TREE, nor in the history of
  # HEAD or of any fetched branch other than the one named branch (git errors fail the step; -z avoids path quoting)
  pat='^handover/(reviews|tickets|evidence)/'
  gl_tmp=$(mktemp)
  git ls-tree -r -z --name-only HEAD > "$gl_tmp" || { echo "git ls-tree failed"; fail=1; }
  if tr '\0' '\n' < "$gl_tmp" | grep -E "$pat"; then echo "files under handover/ are in this checkout's tree: the temporary allowlist would hide generic keys in them"; fail=1; fi
  if [ "$have_branch" = 1 ]; then range="HEAD --all --not origin/core/cloud-handover"; else range="HEAD --all"; fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  git log -m --name-only -z --format= $range -- > "$gl_tmp" || { echo "git log failed"; fail=1; }
  if tr '\0' '\n' < "$gl_tmp" | grep -E "$pat"; then echo "files under handover/ exist in the history of HEAD or of a branch other than core/cloud-handover: the temporary allowlist would hide generic keys in them"; fail=1; fi
  rm -f "$gl_tmp"
fi
exit "$fail"

steps.name: Secrets in the history of the checked-out head (gitleaks, checksum-verified binary)
steps.run:
curl -sSfL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 30 --proto "=https" --proto-redir "=https" --tlsv1.2 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks.tgz" \
  "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
echo "${GITLEAKS_SHA256}  $RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks.tgz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" gitleaks
# scope: only commits reachable from the checked-out head (--log-opts=HEAD). Without it gitleaks scans every fetched
# ref (--all), so another branch's content (handover notes, backup branches) fails every pull request.
"$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks" git --redact --no-banner --exit-code 1 --config .gitleaks.toml --log-opts=HEAD \
  --report-format json --report-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/gl.json" . || {
  # the secret itself is redacted; print only where it is, so a false positive can be fingerprinted
  python3 -c 'import json,sys; [print(f["RuleID"], f["File"], f["StartLine"], f["Commit"][:10], f["Fingerprint"]) for f in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))]' "$RUNNER_TEMP/gl.json"
  exit 1
}

steps.name: Vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and secrets in the files (Trivy, checksum-verified binary)
steps.run:
curl -sSfL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 30 --proto "=https" --proto-redir "=https" --tlsv1.2 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tgz" \
  "https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v${TRIVY_VERSION}/trivy_${TRIVY_VERSION}_Linux-64bit.tar.gz"
echo "${TRIVY_SHA256}  $RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tgz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" trivy
"$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy" fs --skip-dirs .venv --scanners vuln,misconfig,secret --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 --no-progress .
